create_mluke_tokenizer: create an MLukeTokenizer instance with vocab and entity vocab files for multilingual Luke tokenization
encode_entity_spans: encode text with entity spans using MLukeTokenizer to produce input_ids and entity_ids for entity classification tasks
build_input_sequence: build input sequences with entity token spans for entity_pair_classification task using _create_input_sequence
pad_entity_inputs: pad batched encoded inputs with entity_ids, entity_position_ids, and entity_attention_mask using the pad method
save_entity_vocab: save the entity vocabulary file as JSON to a specified directory using save_vocabulary
